metadata.title: Alien-Folk of Zešijómë / Vacío l'Abîme Frénétiacré
metadata.campaign_scope: Interstellar campaigns anywhere in the shared galaxy, whether or not the story centers on Universal.

galaxy_nomenclature.universalian_cultural_reference: The name refers to the gods and the galaxy as a divine trap or devouring bloom.
galaxy_nomenclature.spacefaring_alien_origin: Unknown. Most spacefaring species have explored space for hundreds or thousands of years, and the original meaning has been lost through deep time and language drift.

races.name: Azae’Ioaiz
races.canonical_profile: Large, exceptionally long-lived blue arthropodal beings with a centipede-like head, mandibles, antennae, and dozens to hundreds of jointed legs. Their medium-mass bodies support omnivorous diets and broad individual variation.

base_traits.name: Creature Type
base_traits.description: You are Humanoid with the Alien-Folk tag. A campaign may replace Humanoid with another creature type only when a specific form requires it.

base_traits.name: Size
base_traits.description: Medium or Large.

base_traits.name: Speed
base_traits.description: Your movement speeds are 30 feet; climb 30 feet.

base_traits.name: Hundred-Leg Stability
base_traits.description: You have advantage on checks and saving throws against being knocked prone or moved against your will.

base_traits.name: Arthropodal Climb
base_traits.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, including across ceilings while your hands remain free.

base_traits.name: Mandibles
base_traits.description: Your mandibles are a natural weapon that deals 1d6 piercing damage.

base_traits.name: Ancient Lifespan
base_traits.description: You age extremely slowly. Magic that would age you does so at one-tenth the normal rate.

base_traits.name: Galactic Languages
base_traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one native language and one galactic trade language. Alien communities commonly call the galaxy Zešijómë; Universalians call it Vacío l'Abîme Frénétiacré.

races.balance_and_consent: Species biology, feeding, assimilation, telepathy, and identity mimicry must not remove player agency. Harmful or intimate biological requirements always use explicit table consent and viable non-harmful alternatives.

races.name: Azhurai Striders
races.canonical_profile: Very tall blue-to-lavender bipeds with elongated heads, flexible antennae, swept ears, long limbs, claws, and a carnivorous bite. They favor low-gravity glacial moons and tall cavern arcologies, reading air pressure and nearby motion through their antennae.

races.name: Bratuith
races.canonical_profile: Amphibious winged humanoids with smooth moist skin, powerful aquatic sensory adaptation, two arms, two legs, and leathery wings. Their eyes may be red, yellow, dark, or reflective, and their builds range from lean to athletic.

races.name: Cyai’Syne
races.canonical_profile: Psychically gifted beings with enlarged or laterally extended cranial structures, resonant voices, and the ability to project convincing shared illusions. Their variable profiles may include side-set eyes, paired lower-neck mouths, antlered or rabbit-like facial elements, and herbivorous desert diets.

races.name: Elarin Veilborn
races.canonical_profile: Elegant green-gold humanoids with swept ears, shallow brow ridges, luminous geometric markings, mirrored pupils, and translucent hair tips. They excel at reading facial detail and polarized light and communicate through speech, marking luminosity, controlled shimmer, and formal veil styling.

protected_source_record.name: Yuyeiaeeaiel
protected_source_record.canonicalProfile: Tall armored serpentine beings with elongated heads, narrow lower faces, high crowns, and humanoid arms and hands. Their scaled bodies combine an upright social silhouette with a powerful species-typical serpent form.

base_traits.name: Ability Score Increase
base_traits.description: Increase one ability score by 2 and a different score by 1, or increase three different ability scores by 1.

base_traits.name: Creature Type
base_traits.description: You are Humanoid with the Alien-Folk tag. A campaign may replace Humanoid with another creature type only when a specific form requires it.

base_traits.name: Size
base_traits.description: Medium or Large.

base_traits.name: Speed
base_traits.description: Your movement speeds are 35 feet.

base_traits.name: Serpentine Body
base_traits.description: You have advantage on checks and saves against being knocked prone. You can move through a space one size smaller without squeezing.

base_traits.name: Armored Scales
base_traits.description: When not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

base_traits.name: Constrict
base_traits.description: After you hit with an unarmed strike, you may grapple the target as a bonus action. Uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest.

base_traits.name: Galactic Languages
base_traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one native language and one galactic trade language. Alien communities commonly call the galaxy Zešijómë; Universalians call it Vacío l'Abîme Frénétiacré.

races.balance_and_consent: Species biology, feeding, assimilation, telepathy, and identity mimicry must not remove player agency. Harmful or intimate biological requirements always use explicit table consent and viable non-harmful alternatives.

races.name: Zokrauzaü
races.canonical_profile: Exceptionally agile shapeshifters with variable skin and hair, narrow drooping snouts, and two major body states: a full humanoid body and a limbless flying form. Individual presentation and coloration vary widely.

base_traits.name: Two Major Forms
base_traits.description: As a bonus action, transform between humanoid form and a limbless flying form. Equipment merges or is carried as agreed when chosen.

base_traits.name: Flying Form
base_traits.description: In flying form, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed but cannot wield weapons, manipulate tools, or provide verbal spell components unless the feature is specifically adapted.

base_traits.name: Shifting Surface
base_traits.description: You can alter skin and hair color and minor facial contours. Gain proficiency in Deception or Performance.

base_traits.name: Exceptional Agility
base_traits.description: Gain proficiency in Acrobatics, and opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage once per turn.
